tasks.title: Rounds: keep the Camera Viewer open
tasks.description: Security requires the Camera Viewer to stay open while Custodial is on B-Level. Keep it on a camera that does not show Custodial.
tasks.hint: Security keeps the Camera Viewer open during rounds. Never watch the camera that shows Custodial: watching brings it closer, and session 017 closes the viewer when it shows Custodial. Personnel 000 (Location now) says where Custodial is. To reopen the viewer, double-click Camera Viewer.
tasks.hintDeck: If the viewer keeps closing, you are watching the custodian. Check Personnel 000 for where Custodial is, then watch a different camera. To reopen the viewer, press A twice on Camera Viewer.
